abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Brostamide increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Willow Lane Cohort.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 28 | 250 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 70 | 250 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 37 | 250 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 142 | 250 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 139 | 250 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
